summary: Iteration 2 full-stack regression + new-feature tests for RetOps. Added 3 new pytest cases (recent_interactions shape/status, executive/overview 401 guard, executive/overview payload schema). All 21 pytest cases PASS against public backend URL. UI: drove Playwright with seeded session cookie; verified (1) ROI calculator on landing — all 5 sliders (subs/churn/arpu/cac/recovery) update output totals, With-RetOps recovery card recomputes, 'See your ROI' hero CTA scrolls the calculator into view; (2) QA Dashboard Recent Interactions table — rows render, Send Alert button fires toast 'Alert sent to <agent>'s supervisor' without navigating, clicking a row navigates to /dashboard/interactions/{id}, View All navigates to /dashboard/interactions; (3) Executive View redesign — 4 KPI cards (QA ROI / Customer Satisfaction / Agent Productivity / Cost Savings), Business Impact card, Department Performance card, Risk Alerts & Action Items with HIGH RISK badge present, Take Action navigates to interaction detail; (4) Share Result modal — preview, textarea, Tweet (target=_blank, twitter.com/intent/tweet), LinkedIn (linkedin.com URL), Copy (shows 'Copied' checkmark), Download (triggers retops-share.png), close via X and via backdrop both work. Regression: Upload Interaction page still loads, all existing auth/CRUD/stats endpoints still pass.

issues: Repeated ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED console errors (hot-reload websocket in preview) persist from iteration 1. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: ROICalculator.jsx line 21: fmt() uses nested ternary with no effect — `n >= 1_000_000 ? 2 : 2` always returns 2; harmless but a dead branch, tidy up.
ExecutiveView agent_productivity_delta is derived as (avg_score - 75)/3 — purely a demo formula; document this so ops don't interpret the KPI as real productivity delta.
ShareResultModal html2canvas is imported at module top-level — consider dynamic import to avoid shipping ~50KB in main bundle when share rarely used.
QADashboard Recent Interactions table has no mobile (<lg) fallback — table will overflow horizontally on small screens; acceptable for demo but consider responsive stacking.

/executive/overview uses `next((d for d in all_docs if d['customer']==acc['name']))` to pick latest interaction per account — relies on list_interactions sort order (which isn't applied here since we call db.interactions.find({}) without a sort); may return arbitrary interaction under scale. Sort by created_at desc before the comprehension.
server.py now 619 lines — still within limit but approaching the 700-line split threshold; plan to extract routers (auth, interactions, executive, dashboard) soon.
